title: Subway Surfers
meta_description: Help Jake, Tricky & Fresh escape from the grumpy Inspector and his dog!
full_description: DASH as fast as you can! DODGE the oncoming trains! Help Jake, Tricky & Fresh escape from the grumpy Inspector and his dog. ★ Grind trains with your cool crew! ★ Colorful and vivid HD graphics! ★ Hoverboard Surfing! ★ Paint powered jetpack! ★ Lightning fast swipe acrobatics! ★ Challenge and help your friends! Join the most daring chase! A Universal App with HD optimized graphics.Originally co-developed by SYBO and Kiloo.
